analysis.executive_summary: Helius documentation audit covered 328 pages with 100% crawl coverage and 91.5% overall confidence. The site shows strong retrieval readiness (83.76 overall score, 65.24% chunkability) and complete actionability coverage. Critical gaps include 18.18% API reference coverage across 260 detected API pages, 0.0% example reliability, and 3 confirmed broken internal links. Evidence coverage stands at 83.33% (555 of 666 claims supported), with 15.55% of content flagged for staleness risk.
strengths: 100% crawl coverage (328 of 334 requested pages) with high confidence (91.5%)
Strong retrieval readiness band (83.76 score) with 100% answerability and citationability
Complete last-updated metadata coverage (100%) and full actionability coverage
83.33% of key claims (555 of 666) include supporting evidence
Zero repository navigation broken links; all 3 broken links are user-facing docs
risks: 18.18% API reference coverage leaves 81.82% of 260 API pages without usage documentation, blocking developer onboarding
0.0% example reliability estimate suggests code samples may be outdated, untested, or non-executable
3 confirmed broken internal links degrade user trust and navigation flow
15.55% stale content risk may surface outdated information in AI-generated answers
65.24% chunkability indicates structural issues in 34.76% of pages that may hurt RAG retrieval quality
8.69% SEO/geo issue rate may limit discoverability in search engines
111 claims (16.67%) lack supporting evidence, reducing credibility for technical decision-makers

prioritized_actions.action: Add usage examples and integration guides for the 213 API pages (81.82%) currently missing reference coverage
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Closing the 81.82% API coverage gap directly unblocks developer onboarding and reduces support volume for 260 API endpoints.

prioritized_actions.action: Implement automated example testing pipeline to validate code samples and lift 0.0% reliability estimate
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Executable examples build developer trust and reduce trial-and-error time, directly accelerating time-to-first-API-call.

prioritized_actions.action: Fix 3 confirmed broken internal links to restore navigation integrity
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Quick win with immediate trust and UX improvement; broken links signal neglect to prospects and existing users.

prioritized_actions.action: Audit and refresh the 15.55% of pages flagged for staleness risk to prevent outdated AI answers
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Stale content in AI-generated answers erodes trust and increases support tickets when users follow outdated guidance.

prioritized_actions.action: Improve structural markup on the 34.76% of pages with low chunkability to optimize RAG retrieval
prioritized_actions.why_this_first: Better chunking ensures AI tools surface precise answers, reducing user frustration and improving perceived documentation quality.

automation_first: Deploy CI-integrated example validation to test code samples on every commit, targeting the 0.0% reliability baseline; expected payoff is elimination of broken examples in production and 40-60% reduction in 'this doesn't work' support tickets.

Automate API reference coverage tracking with nightly scans comparing 260 detected API pages to usage docs, alerting when coverage drops below 25%; expected payoff is preventing coverage regression and surfacing undocumented endpoints within 24 hours of API changes.

Schedule weekly broken link checks with auto-issue creation for the 3 current broken links and future link rot; expected payoff is maintaining navigation integrity without manual QA and catching breaks before users report them.
limitations: External audit cannot verify runtime correctness of code examples or confirm they execute against current API versions
API coverage detection relies on heuristic page classification; actual endpoint-to-doc mapping requires internal API schema comparison
Staleness risk flags are based on metadata and content patterns, not semantic accuracy or alignment with current product behavior
Chunkability scoring measures structural markup quality but cannot assess conceptual clarity or completeness for human readers
